raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Refs #41939 (the tool-bearing branch of that report; the "loops even with thinking on" reports there look like a separate cause).

With `--tool-call-parser glm47`, every request that carries non-strict tools gets the full-assistant EBNF. `_process_messages` builds that grammar from the client's raw `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking`:

```python
thinking_mode=True if enable_thinking is None else bool(enable_thinking)
```

GLM-5.3 templates ignore that kwarg: the generation prompt always ends with `<|assistant|><think>`, which is exactly why `template_detection` classifies them as `glm53_always_think` (`ReasoningToggleConfig(special_case="always")`). So a client that still sends `enable_thinking: false` (the GLM-4.5/4.7 habit, or a server-wide `--default-chat-template-kwargs`) gets a grammar with `thinking_block ::= ""` whose text rule excludes every special token, `</think>` included. The model is already inside the think block and the grammar never lets it out. `ReasonerGrammarBackend` passes `full_assistant_ebnf` through unwrapped, so nothing else allows the token either.

What that looks like on a production SGLang build (`c9a8fba99`, `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash`, `--reasoning-parser glm45 --tool-call-parser glm47`, 8×H200, one non-strict `add` tool, `temperature 0`):

| request | finish_reason | completion_tokens | `content` | `tool_calls` | `reasoning_content` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| no `chat_template_kwargs` | `tool_calls` | 40 | empty | `add(a=2, b=2)` | 87 chars |
| `{"enable_thinking": false}` | `length` | 1024 (max) | empty | none | 4107 chars, ends in `I'll make the call. I'll make the call. …` |

## Modifications

- `serving_chat.py`: when the detected template always thinks (`reasoning_config.always_on`), build the glm47 grammar with thinking enabled regardless of `enable_thinking`. Toggle templates (GLM-4.5/4.7) keep the previous behaviour, and so does the no-reasoning-parser case for templates that honour the kwarg.
- Unlike #42761 (thanks @kflansburg for the earlier diagnosis), this keys off the template config rather than `--reasoning-parser`, so a GLM-5.3 deployment without a reasoning parser is covered too; the raw grammar is what gates `</think>` in both setups.

## Accuracy Tests

No model forward code changes. Two regression cases in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py` drive the real `_process_messages` path and compile the returned EBNF with xgrammar:

- always-think template + `enable_thinking: false`, with `--reasoning-parser glm45` and with none: the grammar now accepts `…</think>answer` and `…</think><tool_call>add…</tool_call>`. Both subcases fail on `main`.
- toggle template + `enable_thinking: false`: the grammar still rejects a stray `</think>`.

Results (Python 3.12, CPU): on `main` the always-think case fails in both subtests (`SUBFAILED(reasoning_parser='glm45')`, `SUBFAILED(reasoning_parser=None)`); with the fix both cases pass, and the whole `test_serving_chat.py` passes (157 tests, 104 subtests).

Token-level check with the real `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` tokenizer (same grammar builder as the server, `xgrammar.TokenizerInfo.from_huggingface`), after feeding a thinking prefix:

| grammar | `</think>` accepted after thinking text | `<tool_call>add…</tool_call>` accepted after `</think>` | turn can end |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main`: `thinking_block ::= ""` | no | no | no |
| this PR: `thinking_block ::= thinking_block_content "</think>"` | yes | yes | yes |

I could not restart a patched server on the production GPUs, so the post-fix evidence is the compiled-grammar check above rather than a live run; happy to add one if a reviewer can run it.

cc @JustinTong0323 @zRzRzRzRzRzRzR

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: only the boolean passed to `generate_glm_grammar` changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

detail.title: [Bugfix] Let the GLM47 tool grammar follow always-thinking templates (GLM-5.3)

files.patch:
@@ -1377,13 +1377,18 @@ def _process_messages(
             enable_thinking = (request.chat_template_kwargs or {}).get(
                 "enable_thinking"
             )
+            # GLM-5.3's template opens <think> on every turn and ignores
+            # enable_thinking, so the grammar must keep accepting </think>
+            # or the model can never leave the thinking block.
+            reasoning_config = self.template_manager.reasoning_config
+            glm_thinking_mode = (
+                reasoning_config is not None and reasoning_config.always_on
+            ) or (True if enable_thinking is None else bool(enable_thinking))
             parser = FunctionCallParser(request.tools or [], self.tool_call_parser)
             tool_call_constraint = parser.get_structure_constraint(
                 request.tool_choice,
                 parallel_tool_calls=request.parallel_tool_calls,
-                thinking_mode=True
-                if enable_thinking is None
-                else bool(enable_thinking),
+                thinking_mode=glm_thinking_mode,
             )
 
         # Apply chat template and its stop strings

@@ -1248,6 +1248,87 @@ def test_glm47_without_tools_has_no_tool_call_constraint(self):
 
         self.assertIsNone(processed.tool_call_constraint)
 
+    def _glm47_tool_constraint_ebnf(self, reasoning_config, reasoning_parser):
+        self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
+        self.template_manager.jinja_template_content_format = "string"
+        self.template_manager.reasoning_config = reasoning_config
+        self.tm.tokenizer.apply_chat_template.return_value = [1, 2, 3]
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = "glm47"
+        self.chat.reasoning_parser = reasoning_parser
+
+        req = ChatCompletionRequest(
+            model="x",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2?"}],
+            tools=[
+                {
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {
+                        "name": "add",
+                        "parameters": {
+                            "type": "object",
+                            "properties": {
+                                "a": {"type": "integer"},
+                                "b": {"type": "integer"},
+                            },
+                        },
+                    },
+                }
+            ],
+            chat_template_kwargs={"enable_thinking": False},
+        )
+
+        kind, ebnf = self.chat._process_messages(
+            req, is_multimodal=False
+        ).tool_call_constraint
+        self.assertEqual(kind, "full_assistant_ebnf")
+        return ebnf
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _ebnf_accepts(ebnf, text):
+        import xgrammar as xgr
+
+        compiler = xgr.GrammarCompiler(
+            xgr.TokenizerInfo(
+                [bytes([i]) for i in range(256)], vocab_type=xgr.VocabType.RAW
+            ),
+            max_threads=1,
+        )
+        matcher = xgr.GrammarMatcher(
+            compiler.compile_grammar(xgr.Grammar.from_ebnf(ebnf))
+        )
+        return matcher.accept_string(text) and matcher.is_completed()
+
+    def test_glm47_constraint_lets_always_think_template_close_think(self):
+        """GLM-5.3's generation prompt opens <think> on every turn and ignores
+        enable_thinking, so the model has to emit </think> before its answer
+        or tool call. Building the tool grammar from the raw
+        enable_thinking=False kwarg forbade that token, so every tool-bearing
+        request stayed inside the thinking block until max_tokens (#41939)."""
+        always = ReasoningToggleConfig(special_case="always")
+        tool_call = (
+            "<tool_call>add<arg_key>a</arg_key><arg_value>2</arg_value>"
+            "<arg_key>b</arg_key><arg_value>2</arg_value></tool_call>"
+        )
+        for reasoning_parser in ("glm45", None):
+            with self.subTest(reasoning_parser=reasoning_parser):
+                ebnf = self._glm47_tool_constraint_ebnf(always, reasoning_parser)
+                self.assertTrue(self._ebnf_accepts(ebnf, "2+2 is 4.</think>4"))
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    self._ebnf_accepts(ebnf, f"Use the tool.</think>{tool_call}")
+                )
+
+    def test_glm47_constraint_keeps_rejecting_think_end_for_toggle_template(
+        self,
+    ):
+        """A toggle template really omits the think block when enable_thinking
+        is False, so the grammar must still reject a stray </think> there."""
+        toggle = ReasoningToggleConfig(
+            toggle_param="enable_thinking", default_enabled=True
+        )
+        ebnf = self._glm47_tool_constraint_ebnf(toggle, "glm45")
+        self.assertFalse(self._ebnf_accepts(ebnf, "2+2 is 4.</think>4"))
+        self.assertTrue(self._ebnf_accepts(ebnf, "4"))
+
     def test_jinja_tool_schema_fallback_to_flat_function(self):
         """Fallback to function-only schema when template rejects OpenAI wrapper."""
         self.template_manager.chat_template_name = None
